_meta.note: Curated model debut dates (YYYY-MM-DD = first public availability: API, product access, free tier or open weights, whichever came first). Source of truth for the offline trendsetter badge, which counts a model only when this machine first used it inside the debut window. Add a date only when it was read from a vendor announcement or first-party docs; cite it in `sources`. Models absent from this file get no verdict either way (they still count), so an unfinished catalog never costs an earned tier.
_meta.codenamePolicy: Internal codenames with no public announcement (dfmodel/gfmodel/mmodel, hy4-preview, space-bunny, ...) get their debut from first local use, per owner decision 2026-10-23. They live in `codenames` and always count. Once a vendor reveals what a codename was, move it into the matching `debuts` entry's `also` list so the real release date judges it — that is stricter and is the original badge semantics.
_meta.keyNormalization: Catalog keys and ledger model strings both go through src/lib/pricing/debut-catalog.js canonicalModelKey(): lower-case, provider namespace and （估算）/（积分） suffixes dropped, separators collapsed, a hyphen inserted between a letter and a digit. So the key for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash is written as the readable name and still matches `deepseek-v4-1-flash`. Extra spellings that normalization cannot reach go in that entry's `also` list.
